recommendation.recommended_operator_position: delta_a downstream failure and closure-review gate, upstream of orientation transport and downstream of candidate pruning

recommended_definition_boundaries: Do not define the trigger as Arb_A realization selection.
Do not define the trigger as NavT itself.
Keep orientation generation distinct from orientation reassessment.
Allow invocation from delta_a empty-image, S empty-pruned-pool, closure-threshold loss, or admissible deformation requiring new orientation reference.
Do not bind the trigger to post-realization outcomes.
non_promotion_limits: No topology, geometry, or physics-app promotion.
Do not infer external physical behavior from the control-path audit.
Do not collapse Arb_A, Trigger_Reorient, and NavT into one operator.
